title: Vision Plans Eyeglasses Orders: Late Claims and Retroactive Coverage After the Binder
content:
**Billing and eligibility note — eyeglasses orders on the Vision Plans**

The question whether an eyeglasses order is settled under the materials benefit is answered by the first of these three conditions that holds.

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| The claim reached Cascade more than the filing limit after the date of service: 180 calendar days at a participating location, 365 calendar days out of network | Denied for timely filing. At a participating location the member owes nothing for the order; out of network the member keeps the whole receipt, nothing being reimbursed |
| Otherwise: the enrollment still stands applied, and the funding account's latest binder payment was not returned, is for at least the plan unit's monthly premium for its coverage tier, and was received on or before the binder deadline (the coverage effective date plus 30 calendar days, a payment on the deadline day being in time) | A service dated on or after the coverage effective date is settled under the materials benefit, coverage having started retroactively on that date |
| Otherwise | The enrollment's own status and dates decide: the order is settled under the materials benefit only when the enrollment is active or terminated and the date of service is on or after its coverage effective date and on or before its termination date when it has one; otherwise its lines are denied as not eligible and the member pays the whole retail charge |

**Records read.** The latest binder payment is the funding account's latest payment with payment purpose binder, among the Premium Billing Accounts payments. It counts as returned when a returned-payment entry names it. The filing test compares the claim's received date with its date of service.

**Both sides of each figure**
- 180th day after the date of service at a participating location: in time. 181st: late.
- 365th day out of network: in time. 366th: late.
- Binder received on the 30th day after the coverage effective date: in time. On the 31st: not in time.
- Binder equal to the unit's monthly premium for its tier: sufficient. One cent less: not sufficient.

*Hypothetical case.* An applied enrollment effective 1 April; a binder for the full premium of the unit's tier arrives 1 May and is not returned. Glasses ordered 8 April are settled under the materials benefit. Had the binder arrived 2 May, the enrollment's own status (still applied) would decide, and the lines would be denied as not eligible at the whole retail charge.
